scenes.narration: When you spend 10 dollars at Chipotle, how much of it pays for the food?
About 3 dollars. Food, drinks and packaging were 29.6 percent of sales in 2025.

visual.label: food, beverage and packaging share of sales, 2025

scenes.narration: Another 2 dollars and 50 cents pays the crew. Labor was about 25 percent.
About 2 dollars covers rent and other costs. The last 2 dollars and 50 cents is restaurant profit.
That math ran across 11.9 billion dollars of sales, plus a record 334 new restaurants.
